annotations.title: Is this UK employer a licensed visa sponsor?

description: Job Spotter. Is this UK employer a licensed visa sponsor? For "does Deliveroo sponsor visas?", "can this company sponsor a Skilled Worker visa?". Looks the employer up in the UK Home Office register of licensed sponsors (workers), with its town and the visa routes it is licensed for, and the register date. A licence means the employer can sponsor; each job still has to qualify. Company names on the register are legal names, so try the legal name if the brand name is not found. For US jobs, the visa_sponsorship field on search results comes from the advert. Register data contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.

company.description: The employer, for example "Tesco" or its legal name "Tesco Stores Limited".
